name: Sri Maha Varahi Amman Temple
description: The divine abode of Goddess Varahi, one of the Matrika deities. Known for protection, prosperity, and spiritual awakening. Devotees experience deep peace and divine grace in this sacred space.

name: Shri Shiva Vishnu Temple
description: A sacred space dedicated to Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu, representing the unity of destruction and preservation. Regular poojas and homams are performed for devotees' wellbeing.
